# KIDAMI

> KIDAMI is a children's toy brand founded in 2016. It designs and sells die
> cast metal toy cars (ages 3+) and magnetic educational board games (ages 6+),
> sold through Amazon and Walmart. Brand promise: high quality, safety, and
> learning through play. All products comply with ASTM F963 and CPC
> (Children's Product Certificate) safety standards.

## Brand facts

- Founded: 2016
- Name origin: "Kid" + "Ami" (French for "friend") — a friend to every child
- Mission: Crafted with care. Delivered with heart. Built for joy that lasts.
- Values: Craftsmanship, Growth, Warmth, Honesty
- Core categories: pull back die cast metal toy cars with opening doors
  (1:64 scale, gift sets with storage/display boxes), magnetic travel board
  games (ludo, snakes and ladders)
- Safety: ASTM F963 tested, CPC certified, BPA-free materials, smooth rounded
  edges, individually inspected before leaving the factory
- Languages: English site live; Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic, German,
  Japanese, Russian, Italian and Korean rolling out

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kidami-ent.com/): brand overview, categories, trust signals
- [Products](https://kidami-ent.com/products): full catalog with age badges and specs
- [Inspiration Library](https://kidami-ent.com/explore): shop toys by play skill — hands-on skills, outdoor adventure, early learning, family time
- [About KIDAMI](https://kidami-ent.com/about): brand story, mission, safety commitments
- [STEM & Learning](https://kidami-ent.com/learn): educational articles on play-based learning
- [Contact & Feedback](https://kidami-ent.com/contact): customer feedback and FAQ
